notes: Homonym check (cross-reference flagged by Strong's own entry, "probably rather identical with H5472 through the idea of shrinking from a load"): shares consonants סוג with H5472 ("backslide"), already in this dataset. The corpus tags this occurrence to 5473 specifically, with a distinct sense ("hem in, bind" vs. H5472's "turn back, backslide"). Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H5472 has been retroactively relabeled סוג¹ in this same batch and this root is סוג². Ref follows WLC/Hebrew versification (Song.7.3); English Bibles number this verse 7:2.
